items.title: Alzheimer’s disease target and drug discovery by leveraging multiomics and electronic health data
items.author: Feixiong Cheng
items.content: Hou et al. show a drug target compendium supported by human genetic and real-world patient data for Alzheimer’s disease and validate epoxide hydrolase 2 as a causal Alzheimer’s disease target using CRISPR interference and gene editing experiments in human models.

items.title: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport deficits in C9ORF72 amyotrophic lateral sclerosis motor neurons
items.author: Bhuvaneish T. Selvaraj
items.content: Astrocytes regulate axonal mitochondrial transport in motor neurons through mitochondrial bioenergetics, a process disrupted in C9ORF72-mediated amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Enhancing astrocytic mitochondrial metabolism restores transport deficits.

items.title: Modality-specific reactive and predictive responses in the human superior colliculus
items.author: Jordan E. Theriault-Brown
items.content: Chen et al. use 7-Tesla fMRI to show that the human superior colliculus has modality-specific, depth-dependent activity prior to visual or somatosensory events, resembling its response to actual stimulation.

items.title: Human claustrum neurons encode uncertainty and prediction errors during aversive learning
items.author: Eyiyemisi C. Damisah
items.content: Human claustrum neurons track uncertainty and prediction errors during aversive learning, suggesting a role for the claustrum in updating beliefs and guiding adaptive behavior in dynamic environments.
